title: Pytest Starter Companion
description: Runnable Python 3.11 + pytest 8.3 starter project mirroring the QAPractices tutorial: Calculator and checkout tests, fixtures, parametrize, markers, pytest.ini, coverage and a GitHub Actions workflow.
description_es: Proyecto ejecutable de Python 3.11 + pytest 8.3 que replica el tutorial de QAPractices: tests de Calculator y checkout, fixtures, parametrize, markers, pytest.ini, coverage y un workflow de GitHub Actions.
